agenda_items.title: Component Creator Tab — Functional Specification for 3D Mesh Component Editor
agenda_items.intent_description: Define a UI component for creating or subclassing 3D mesh components within a user-editable canvas system. Includes Browser (list/existing components), Editor (canvas-based with JSON schema backing), and Live Preview components. JSON schema defines validation rules, type constraints, and relationships. Persistence strategies include local storage and API-backed save/load.
requirements: Browser: list existing components with search/filter
Editor: canvas-based with JSON schema definition
Live Preview: real-time render of component
JSON schema for validation and constraints
